title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Marriage hindrance 1907 views Q. Dream 1441 views Q. I am an employee of autonomous body and very busy with my job. I am living in developing new residential area since last 10 years. As per requirement the construction of a new masjid became necessary in our locality. For which a committe was formed and I become an office bearer of the masjid committee. I involve myself only for the cause of that all the constuction work of the masjid should be done as per the shari'a i.e. avoiding haram funds and materials. As I am very busy with my job and I offer daily five salat anywhere or in the house if the jama'at times over. Since I am not punctual to attend that local masjid to offer all five salat, hence some musalliyan are blaming me for the "khokli seerat" and say that "ta'ajjub hai aap ghar per namaz pade aur masjid doosron ke liye banaye". On continuous blaming by the musalliyan, now I want to leave membership from the masjid committee. Whereas 40% work of the constuction is remain to complete. And no other member look after the work carefully and maintain the shara'i oosool. May I leave this as majority of muslliyan dislike me? Please guide me what should I do? 2107 views Q. I am running an Stock Broking Firm in Mumbai. We are Sub Broker for Angel Broking Limited. I wish to know that are my earning Halal or Haraam. Please send the fatwa. 1826 views Q. Assalamu alaikum, i would like to know the meaning of a dream that a friend of mine had. recently her mother passed away, after her mother passed away close friends and relatives told her often that they see her mother in their dreams. after hearing this from her friends she prayed to Allah asking Allah that she wants to see her mother in her dream.That night she had a dream about her mother, in the dream she saw that her mother was buried, but family members and other people had to get her out becuase she was going to have a baby, after her mother was brought out, her mother was taken to the hospital to have her baby, theN she saw that she was running to see her mother, but she was told by doctors that her mother was in the hospital basement, so she ran to the basement but when she got there she saw her mother in a bag the way she was when she first died. My friend would like to know the meaning of this dream. Jazakallah 2191 views Q. A lady relative suddenly went like mad woman, i prayed tahajjud & made dua for her,then went to sleep. i dreamed i was in sleeping position and she came towards me and dissolved in me (like she submitted her life to me) Whats the meaning please? 1423 views Q. dream of tawaf 4474 views Q. My wife saw a dream and I would like the tabir of the dream, please. She saw our son M.Zahid (4 years old)inside a well and he is wearing a white topi. My wife goes in the well to save him and picks him with one hand, and the water in the well was dirty (matyala). Jazzak Allahu Kheir, remember us in your Dua's. 1395 views Q. Assalamualaikum dear mufti sahab, my question is regarding interpretation of a dream i saw last night. I saw that i was with a girl (asma) whom i had tried to marry as i loved her but it didnt happen due to various circumstances & i got married to another girl (arshiya), Asma is still unmarried. I saw that she was with me as my wife & with my current wife (arshiya) & my mom cooking rotis in the kitchen. I was asking her to go & sleep as she has to go to work the next day. there were other things as well which i dont remember properly such seeing her use a table spoon to hit my mom on her head jokingly & then my mom said that she already has a wound on her head. there were other things as well which i dont remember. request you to please provide me tabeer of this dream. Jazakallah, Naveed Afroz 1477 views Q. I Wanted to ask you about my dream please say the tabeer of it first I saw a few honey bees and after that me and my brother started journey and a person asked him for a blanket I told him to give from throwing from the train but he but down and he missed the train so on the next station i to got down and again i started a journey to get him but the train diverted and came to a place named as "allow" there I saw the dargah and I again sat on the train it took me to the next station there was another dargah and very few people than the dargah I visited earlier. Then I again came back to my home and after few time my brother to came back .To inform you that my brother is in jamaat now and I was eager to go but due to some reason I cant is this some confusing dream good bad or shaitan's handiwork. 1551 views Q. I have seen in my dream that i was sitting in my room in hostel with friends.I take my soap to go to bathroom.Around bathtoom are four big cats wandering about. they say "we dont say anything to anybody until somebody says anything anything to us." i get scared and come back and tell my friends.they say we will talk to the hostel warden about it that there are many cats in hostel.in the meantime, another friend who is fond of cats comes and take them out.and there appeats another very big black cat that i haven't seen before.and my eyes opened.Please tell me is this dream of some importance or a usual bad dream? 1342 views Q. میری امی نے خواب دیکھا کہ وہ کھیت کے راستے سے جارہی ہیں اور اچانک سے ان کا سارا گہنہ (زیور) مثلاً کان کی بالی اور گلے کا ہار نیچے گرجاتے ہیں، اور جیسے ہی اس کو اٹھانے کے لیے جھکتی ہیں تو وہ سب سانپ بن جاتے ہیں اورپھنکارنے لگتے ہیں۔ براہ کرم، تعبیر بتائیں۔ 1503 views Q. Sometime back I saw a dream and I would be grateful if u could give me tabeer for the same. I saw that I am standing just outside my house in the lane. Some lions are approaching me from the other end. I am a little scared. But when they come close to me, the lions become meek and submissive. And I realise that though I was afraid of them, they are actually here to help and protect me. Soon, I see these lions stand next to me to counter the lions coming from the opposite direction. Pl guide with a tabeer. 1455 views Q. My father , mother & myself ALHAMDULILLAH done our hajj but after seven days coming from hajj my father died (inteqhal). after 3 months on friday before asar salah the same day our weekly gust(ijtema) were there i saw my father in dream and he telling that today is friday come on getup and go today is your gust (ijtema). please explain me. 1559 views Q. I have been seeing a lot of deep sea/ocean in my dreams since school days. Sometimes I am with my husband near the sea/ocean in my dream. Please interpret. 2485 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 43671 Country: India Title: یاسین پڑھنا Question: (۱) میں نے خواب دیکھا ہے کہ فجر کی نماز پڑھ رہا تھا، سورة یاسین پڑھانا تھا اور میرے سے امام صاحب نے کہا کہ تم پڑھاؤ ، میں نے منع کردیا کہ مجھے یاد نہیں ہے، اس خواب کی تعبیر بتائیں۔ دوسرے دن صبح میں نے گھر میں سورہ یاسین کی تلاوت کی ۔ (۲) گذشتہ سال 8500 زکاة دینی تھی ا ور میں دے نہیں سکا، کیا اس سال دونوں سال کی زکاة ایک ساتھ دے سکتاہوں؟ Answer ID: 43671 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! فتوی: 159-123/H=3/1434 (۱) ماشاء اللہ عمدہ خواب ہے، تعبیر یہ ہے کہ راحتِ دارین ان شاء اللہ مرحمت ہوگی، البتہ سورہٴ یاسین شریف وغیرہ کا اہتمام نماز میں بھی رکھنا چاہیے۔ (۲) جلد از جلد دونوں سال کی پوری پوری زکاة ادا کردیں۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
